name: Olympas
overview: Olympas is a male figure mentioned in the New Testament to whom the Apostle Paul sends greetings. The biblical record does not provide information about his tribal affiliation or additional personal details. His mention in the epistle to the Romans highlights his connection to the early Christian community.
namesAndTitles: The name Olympas appears as a proper name in Scripture with no specific meaning or divine origin noted. It is simply recorded as Olympas in Romans 16:15.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record family relationships for Olympas beyond the greeting sent to him by Paul. There is no further information about his relatives or social connections.
scriptureSignificance: Olympas is significant as a member of the early church who is personally greeted by Paul, indicating his recognized presence and possibly his contribution within the Christian community. His inclusion in Paul's greetings underscores the communal nature of the early church.
